tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the default for screens on the shop floor.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Drawers, popovers, inputs on a surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, grid lines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, axis labels, timestamps, on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Profender red. Logo and the Alarm state only. Never a button, link or chart series.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Red text that must be read (an alarm count, a negative delta) on bg or surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the selected nav item.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of Set Up tiles and of focused inputs.

tokens.name: chart-auto
tokens.usage: Chart series: automatic count (Auto, Tightening 01).

tokens.name: chart-manual
tokens.usage: Chart series: manual count (Manual, Tightening 02).

tokens.name: chart-target
tokens.usage: Target line, drawn dashed. Never red.

tokens.name: below-target-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an hour cell below target.

tokens.name: on-target-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an hour cell at or above target.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Prompt for page titles and section headings. Thai and Latin.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Sarabun for everything read. Thai never below 12px.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Tabular numerals for counts, targets, times and codes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; tile gap in a line block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of tiles and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Machine tiles, hour cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and line blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips.
